about: The spine between the practice dot phrase and the spoken script. Every canonical sentence belongs to one line of the block, or is listed in guide_only with the reason no line says it. A covered line's numbers are practice-level: fixed for this practice's version of the guide, so they may be spoken. A field line's value comes from the patient's link, so nothing it owns may speak a number — validate-template-lines.mjs enforces that. Beat and chapter are not stored here; they are derived from the segments file, which is their one source of truth.

follow up.why: The link carries this patient's date, so the sentence names no interval: the clinic gives the date.

antibiotic.why: The link says whether these beats play at all. The drug, dose and days stay in the provider's note.

pain medication.why: The link says whether these beats play at all. The drug and schedule stay in the provider's note.

guide_only.wc.10: The guide says stitches dissolve. No line of the block mentions it; it comes from the CI Center handout.
